title: VDE VM Type Configuration
description: Schema for VDE VM type static configuration. Defines minimal required fields for VM provisioning, startup, and SSH access. Runtime state (SSH ports, container status) is managed separately.

description.description: Optional description of this configuration file

vms.description: VM type definitions organized by category

languageVM.description: Development language VM configuration. Container name: {name}-dev, SSH port: dynamically allocated.

name.description: VM identifier (lowercase alphanumeric). Used for container naming, SSH config, directories.

install.description: Shell command for container provisioning (runs as root)

port.description: Must be null for language VMs (no service ports)

serviceVM.description: Infrastructure service VM configuration. Container name: {name}, SSH port: dynamically allocated, service ports: defined here.

name.description: VM identifier (lowercase alphanumeric). Used for container naming, SSH config, directories.

install.description: Shell command for container provisioning (runs as root)

port.description: Service port(s) to expose (comma-separated integers: '80' or '80,443')
